extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH grant biosketches (e.g., K-series and other NIH applicants and mentors)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing individual biographical sketches for Senior/Key personnel and other significant contributors for NIH grant applications, following the NIH-formatted BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH sections and page limits. Includes Personal Statement, Education/Training, Contributions to Science, Positions/Honors, and Research Support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply this format and five-page limit to each individual's biosketch submitted with the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: NAME and eRA Commons user name
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the person's full name and their eRA Commons user name/credential as part of the header information.

rubrics_metrics.name: POSITION TITLE
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the current position title (institutional role) exactly as used on institutional records; used to identify the individual's role on the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training (table content and order)
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a table (or rows) with columns for INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); Completion Date MM/YYYY; FIELD OF STUDY. Begin with undergraduate/baccalaureate and proceed through subsequent training; include internships/residencies/fellowships and postdoctoral training when relevant. Add or delete rows to fit the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise personal statement describing research interests, relevant experience, mentoring/clinical/research roles, and why the individual is well suited to contribute to the proposed project (examples in the document show linking the individual's expertise and mentoring capacity to the applicant's aims).

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Employment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions and employment history with dates (years). Include academic and relevant non-academic positions that demonstrate qualifications for the role; order and format can follow the example (years then position).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Experience and Professional Memberships
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List other relevant professional activities and memberships (e.g., society memberships, panels, working groups) that reflect service and engagement in the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide notable honors and awards (with year) to document recognition and distinction relevant to the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present succinct, numbered descriptions of up to several major scientific contributions/areas (each entry is a short paragraph summarizing the contribution). For each contribution, list selected relevant publications (lettered a, b, c, ...) that exemplify the work; include citation details and PMCIDs/PMIDs where available. Use this section to highlight how the individual's work has advanced the field and relevance to the proposed research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete list of published work (MyBibliography link)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/myncbi/…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a link to the individual's complete MyBibliography (or equivalent), and/or reference that a complete publication list is available there; the example includes a URL with sorting parameters.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (ongoing and completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. SELECTED RESEARCH SUPPORT: (Ongoing Research Support; Selected Past/Completed Research Support)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List active and completed research support with grant numbers, funding agency, PI name, role on the grant (e.g., Role: PI; Role: Co-Investigator; Role: Director of Epi/Biostat Core), project title/goal, and dates of support. Provide a brief description of project aims/goal and the individual's role. Separate ongoing and completed support and include administrative supplements as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation of grant roles and contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: When listing research support include the grant number, PI name, role, project title/goal, and dates (e.g., 'U01-AI-42590 (Stephen J. Gange & Elizabeth Golub, dual PI) Role: PI & Member of Executive Committee; WIHS Data Management and Analysis Center (WDMAC)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format entries to make clear the project, funding ID, leadership (PI/co-PI), the individual's specific role, and dates; use this structure to permit reviewers to assess level of contribution and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of section-specific examples and citations
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of exemplar paragraphs and selected citations (including PMCID/PMID) to demonstrate contributions and context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document provides example paragraphs and selected publications (with PMCID/PMID and citation details) illustrating how to populate 'Contribution to Science' and 'Personal Statement' sections. Use these conventions when possible to increase clarity and verifiability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target personnel applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This biosketch format is explicitly intended for Senior/Key personnel and other significant contributors on the grant; ensure each listed individual uses this format.
